description:
Hi Focus Friends, I'm Aron! After graduating #1 and getting into Harvard, my life unraveled. 

At 33 years old, I was broke, divorced, and earning just above minimum wage. 

Shortly thereafter, I was diagnosed with ADHD (Inattentive type). In the years since then, I have built a thriving Fortune 500 career working with leading companies like Marriott, Deloitte, Johnson & Johnson, United Healthcare, McDonald's, KPMG, and more. I am happily remarried and finally feel in control of my life.

This channel is called "Hidden" ADHD because I was NOT hyperactive, so my ADHD went "under the radar." I believe there are many other adults that are living below their potential because of non-hyperactive ADD.

I am not a medical professional, but I've learned that ADHD is very manageable. In this channel, I share all of the tools, insights, and science-backed strategies I used to turn my life around. My earnest desire is for you to live the life of your dreams!

Warmly,
